card.name: Capital H or P starting split words
card.fires_on: The lone letter H (or P) that begins a word split into pieces, e.g. the H in Sedatives/Hypnotics, HCV, HIV, or Pilsner. Mostly in drug-label headings and capitalized warnings.

modes.label: Sedative-hypnotics
modes.description: The slash or joint between 'Sedatives' and 'Hypnotics', where the H is split off.
